# M02 Control Entry Point Report

- Date: 2026-08-26
- Status: Completed

M02 delivered the repository-local `python tools/control.py` bootstrap, centralized
repository path discovery, local environment diagnostics, install workflow, and
Godot command dispatch. The installed Python package remains `g2dtool`, and the
primary installed command remains `g2d`.

The milestone is closed by v0.1.0 with the public template aliases updated to
`forge2d-template` and `Forge2D-Template`.
